rawContent: I listen very, very carefully when men complain that #metoo is going "too far." It tells me exactly where to find the lines they have crossed.

I don't yet know what to do with the women who also protest #metoo with their own anecdotes of acceptable harassment. 

My friend's woman coworker told him, "*I* have had people hug me and touch me at work without asking and it doesn't bother *me*. What's the big deal??"
